candidates.claim: The OT_IN entry at fw-01:79 permits tcp from 10.10.10.0/24 to the reporting server 192.168.30.20 on port 443, a direct OT-to-CORP path that is not an approved cross-zone service (only historian-to-reporting A6 is approved).
candidates.remediation: Remove the OT_IN entry at fw-01:79 so OT reaches the reporting server only through the historian as approved service A6.

candidates.claim: The baseline delta reports that the access-list OT_IN entry at fw-01:79 was added relative to the approved baseline and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added OT_IN entry at fw-01:79 with the approved baseline by either approving it or reverting it.

clarifications.question: The registry says only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10, but it also approves trunks that carry VLAN 10 (sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/24, sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 and sw-core-01 Gi1/0/24). Should those approved VLAN 10 trunks be treated as compliant with I3?
